itemListElement.name: Best AI Meeting Summarizer Tools in the US for 2026

mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize a Teams meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Microsoft Teams can summarize meetings with Copilot, which requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Without one, third-party tools such as Lynkk, Fathom, Fireflies, Otter and Read AI also handle Teams calls. One habit worth keeping: verify owners and dates before any summary reaches the wider team.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free AI meeting summarizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom summarizes unlimited calls for free. Otter, Read AI and Lynkk offer free tiers too, each with a monthly ceiling. Fathom has no cap at all; Otter allows 300 minutes at 30 minutes per call, Read AI 5 meetings, and Lynkk 5 notes of up to 2 hours.

mainEntity.name: Where do I find the AI summary in Zoom?

acceptedAnswer.text: In your inbox and your Zoom account, if you're the host. Once AI Companion's meeting summary is on, Zoom emails the recap after the call and keeps a copy in the host's account. Sharing with participants is up to the host. AI Companion comes with paid Zoom Workplace plans and covers Zoom meetings only.

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet summarize meetings automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Meet can summarize meetings with Take notes for me if your Workspace edition or Google AI plan includes it. It isn't fully automatic. Someone must turn it on for each meeting, or the organizer can enable it from the calendar event, and the notes land in the organizer's Google Drive.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI meeting summary take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually a few minutes. Most AI summarizers deliver a recap shortly after the meeting ends, though longer sessions and video recordings can take a little more time to process. Before sharing, review names, numbers and owners, the details AI summaries get wrong most often.

mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize meetings in Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some tools can. Lynkk supports Hindi, plus a Hinglish setting for speakers who mix Hindi and English. Google Meet's Take notes for me leaves Hindi off its 8 languages.
